terra.problem: The passage does not say Habakkuk said these words out loud.
A dragnet is not something one would ordinarily find in a tackle box, so the claim about every tool in the verse is inaccurate.
The text says the foe rejoices, but it does not state that he feels no sorrow at all.
Habakkuk says he will station himself and watch; the passage does not say he is already watching from the ramparts.
The explanation says Habakkuk is on the wall keeping watch, but the passage records what he says he will do.
The drawer joke refers to Papa Dorin's backstory without saying he spent years in a drawer.
The LORD says to write clearly so a herald may run with the vision. The passage does not say someone will definitely do so.
The passage does not say clear writing allows the herald to move quickly.
The reference to Papa Dorin waiting in the dark does not explain that he was in a drawer.
The quarter joke relies on unexplained backstory and does not clearly connect his purchase price to his wallet.
